name: Legacy repro

entry_conditions: no purchase within 1h arming window after add_to_cart
cart non-empty after the 1h arming window
messageable on >= 1 channel (consent checked per channel per step)
device-scoped identity only (user_pseudo_id; no cross-device stitching)

other_exits: unsubscribe (exits that channel's steps; whole journey if it was the only consented channel)

steps.branch_condition: begin_checkout or add_payment_info fired since add_to_cart, no purchase
no begin_checkout since add_to_cart, and login or session_start fired since abandonment

kpis.name: Sepet kurtarma oranı
kpis.definition: 7 günlük pencere içinde purchase / girenler; holdout'a karşı artımsal lift olarak ölçülür

kpis.name: Gönderim başına abonelikten çıkma
kpis.definition: unsubscribe / teslim edilen, e-posta adımı başına

kpis.name: Push izin iptal oranı
kpis.definition: push izin iptali / teslim edilen push

experiment.ab_test: step-1 konu satırı: Varyant A ('Sepetin seni bekliyor') vs Varyant B ('{{product_name}} hâlâ sepetinde') — hipotez: ürün adı geçen konu daha yüksek açılma getirir

data_gaps: No true user_id — identity is device-scoped user_pseudo_id only. Cross-device purchase cannot fire the success exit and cross-device purchasers cannot be excluded; a completed purchase on another device may still receive a 'sepetin duruyor' send. Identity stitching would close this and is the top tracking-plan item.

cart_value is not a mapped attribute — no low-cart-value exclusion floor and no value-tiered messaging; incentive is gated on plan_type instead. Could be computed CRM-side from add_to_cart/remove_from_cart with drift risk.
inventory_level is not mapped — honest low-stock urgency (per the pattern's honest-scarcity rule) cannot fire; step 6 uses real cart-expiry framing only.

email/push open+click are CRM-native engagement signals, not GA4 mapped events — branch tiers are keyed on mapped funnel events (begin_checkout / add_payment_info / login) rather than opens, keeping every branch condition inside the mapped list.
